due_when.clears_when: the self-test disables git auto-gc/maintenance in its temp repos, or 20 consecutive CI runs pass without this OSError

origin.rerun: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mandate_autoland.py -k planted_defect --count 20 (or loop 20x); any 'Directory not empty' reproduces it

what: tests/test_mandate_autoland.py::test_planted_defect_suite_passes failed on PR #13543 head 813de3f2 (CI run 36409566135) with OSError: [Errno 39] Directory not empty: 'objects'. The crash is in scripts/ci/check_mandate_autoland.py _case(), where tempfile.TemporaryDirectory().__exit__ cleans up the throwaway git repo for NEGATIVE 3. It passed on the previous head and passes locally (8/8), so it is intermittent. INFERRED cause: a git process (detached gc --auto or maintenance) still writing into .git/objects during rmtree. Proposed fix: run the self-test's git calls with -c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false (_git/_run). A guard that fails intermittently on unrelated PRs costs every lane a re-run.
